name: Moroccan chickpea and lamb tagine
steps: Brown the diced lamb in oil with the onion.
Stir in cumin, cinnamon, ginger, and paprika until fragrant.
Add the tinned tomatoes, chickpeas, and a little water.
Cover and simmer gently until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the dried apricots and cook a few minutes more.
Scatter with chopped coriander before serving.
